name: Hearts Bar
author: fizzly using Claude
description:
Displays hears bar for player's HP.

AI WARNING!!! This plugin is vibecoded by Claude.

defaultParameters.name: hideSwitch
defaultParameters.description:
Switch to temporary hide hearts bar. Turn ON to hide.
Select "variable" type and link to a variable for switching during events.
Default: Switch= OFF

defaultParameters.name: fullColor
defaultParameters.description:
HEX colour for full heart container.
Default: #ff0000 (red)

defaultParameters.name: emptyColor
defaultParameters.description:
HEX colour for empty heart container.
Default: #000000 (black)

defaultParameters.name: outlineColor
defaultParameters.description:
HEX colour for outlines (if outlineWidth>0).
Default: #ffffff (white)

defaultParameters.name: outlineWidth
defaultParameters.description:
Outline thickness for hearts (in pixels).
Default: 0

defaultParameters.name: heartCount
defaultParameters.description:
Amout of hearts to display on bar.
Default: 10

defaultParameters.name: posX
defaultParameters.description:
X position for hearts bar (in pixels).
Default: 10

defaultParameters.name: posY
defaultParameters.description:
Y position for hearts bar (in pixels).
Default: 10

defaultParameters.name: commonReactionID
defaultParameters.description:
Common reaction called when HP=0 (no hearts).
If you don't need to call any actions when HP=0, then set as Number=0.
Default: 4, but need to be changed for your needs.
